+        visible = pl.max(pl.min(pl.min(length // COMPRESS_RATIO, last_end // COMPRESS_RATIO), MAX_CANDIDATES), 0)
+    else:
+        owner, first, live, visible = indexer_decode_group(bounds, lengths, positions, offsets, group, GROUP_SIZE)
+    return owner, first, live, visible
+
+
+@pl.jit.inline(auto_scope=False)
+def indexer_score_query_visibility(
+    uniform_six: pl.Scalar[pl.INT32],
+    bounds: pl.Tensor[[QUERY_BOUNDS_DYN], pl.INT32],
+    lengths: pl.Tensor[[REQUESTS_DYN], pl.INT32],
+    positions: pl.Tensor[[TOKENS_DYN], pl.INT64],
+    request: pl.Scalar[pl.INDEX],
+    query: pl.Scalar[pl.INDEX],
+):
+    """等长分支只省掉已证明的Q/position检查；每条query的causal上界不合并。"""
+    if uniform_six != 0:
+        length = pl.cast(pl.read(lengths, [request]), pl.INDEX)
+        query_end = length - 6 + query - request * 6 + 1
+        visible = pl.max(pl.min(pl.min(length // COMPRESS_RATIO, query_end // COMPRESS_RATIO), MAX_CANDIDATES), 0)
+        causal = pl.cast(1, pl.INT32)
+    else:
+        visible, causal = indexer_query_visibility(bounds, lengths, positions, request, query)
+    return visible, causal
